title: MM-OPERA: Benchmarking Open-ended Association Reasoning for Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (score rates) across different cultural reference groups (e.g., Western, East Asian, South Asian, Arabic-Islamic) in associative reasoning tasks to identify structural disparities.
Evaluating and comparing model performance (score rates and harmonic means) on associative reasoning tasks presented in English versus 14 non-English languages to observe multilingual imbalances.
Calculating the Pearson correlation coefficient between the length of the evaluated model's response and the score assigned by the LLM-as-a-Judge to verify if longer answers are unfairly favored.
Conducting permutation tests by randomly shuffling the order of standard and model-generated answers in the LLM judge's prompt and measuring the mean score differences.
Comparing the score distributions and average reasoning scores when an LLM (e.g., GPT-4o) evaluates its own generated responses versus when an independent LLM (e.g., DeepSeek-V3) evaluates them.
